SUSTAIN combines expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation to address complex challenges related to human and environmental health, climate change, and resource efficiency, developing knowledge, methods, and transferable software for the simulation and comprehensive sustainability assessment of socio-economic systems. Its purpose is to foster sustainable eco-innovation, through products and technologies, as well as support sustainability-oriented policy implementation and behavioural change to promote decarbonisation transitions.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The world faces a convergence of crises that are transforming the conditions for human development. Climate instability, ecosystem degradation, and the overuse of natural resources have reached critical levels, while social inequality, political fragmentation, and technological disruption are reshaping societies. Traditional notions of economic competitiveness, centred on growth and productivity, are being redefined to include social resilience, inclusiveness, and ecological integrity. Responding to this “polycrisis” requires new pathways that reconcile prosperity with planetary and social limits. Luxembourg offers a particularly illustrative example of these tensions. The country enjoys one of the highest income levels globally and a dynamic financial and business environment that sustains its reputation for economic success. Yet this prosperity depends strongly on cross-border commuting, which creates mobility challenges and environmental stress. Escalating housing prices have made access to affordable living increasingly difficult, displacing a significant share of the workforce beyond national borders. The reliance on imported energy leaves households and firms vulnerable to external shocks. Although Luxembourg's welfare model and social dialogue remain robust, they are under pressure from rising costs of living, widening inequalities, and growing demands on public services. Environmentally, Luxembourg's footprint per inhabitant ranks among the largest worldwide, driven by high consumption and land-use pressures that push the country beyond sustainable limits.

Meeting these intertwined challenges calls for coordinated transformations that bridge sectors, disciplines, and scales. Economic and social progress must be reframed within the concept of a Safe Operating Space—an area in which human well-being is achieved without breaching environmental boundaries. The objective is to steer innovation, governance, and everyday practices toward forms of competitiveness that are compatible with sustainability, rather than in conflict with it. The Doctoral Training Unit C-SOS (Competitiveness within a Safe Operating Space) is designed to cultivate researchers capable of analysing and fostering such transformations. It brings together an interdisciplinary consortium to train 12 PhD candidates in the assessment and design of inclusive and sustainable development trajectories. The programme equips them with conceptual and methodological tools to connect environmental sustainability, social well-being, and economic dynamics into integrated frameworks for decision-making. Its ambition is to inform socio-economic policies, encourage responsible industrial and technological innovation, and contribute to more equitable and resilient societies. Luxembourg provides an ideal environment for this initiative, combining strong expertise in sustainability science and policy analysis. The DTU is a collaboration between researchers at the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST), the University of Luxembourg (UL) and the Urban Development and Mobility Department at the Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER). The consortium also includes the National Statistics Office (STATEC). In this DTU, 12 scientists will train 12 PhD students over six years (from January 2027), each obtaining a PhD from UL's doctoral schools.

As part of the C-SOS Doctoral Training Unit, in this PhD you will integrate concepts from Post-Growth, Sufficiency and Doughnut Economics into the downscaling of planetary boundaries, leveraging good examples of application to territories and cities. Possible research questions include: how to couple ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system? How to define social foundation? How to allocate the carrying capacity based on social foundation?.

You will be embedded in the SUSTAIN unit at LIST and enrolled as a doctoral candidate at the University of Luxembourg. You will work closely with a diverse cohort of 12 PhD researchers across the social, economic, and environmental sciences, contributing to a shared research agenda on how Luxembourg can thrive within its fair share of planetary limits

You will be mainly in charge of:
• Conducting a systematic review and critical assessment of existing carrying capacity allocation and planetary boundary downscaling approaches, spanning economic and emission based allocation methods, sufficiency based approaches, and Doughnut Economics frameworks
• Developing a methodological framework for coupling ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system, integrating Post-Growth, Sufficiency, and Doughnut Economics concepts into the downscaling of planetary boundaries
• Applying the framework to Luxembourg and comparable small territories under a range of allocation scenarios, drawing on Green Deal technology targets, context specific Decent Living Standards, and provisioning systems, producing environmental ceiling estimates grounded in social foundation thresholds
• Building and maintaining a dynamic system model enabling the testing of individual and combined allocation approaches, valuing social outcome generation per unit of environmental impact across relevant planetary boundary dimensions
• Collaborating with other C-SOS doctoral researchers, in particular those working on social foundation, Quality of Life, and economic systems, to ensure that allocation approaches rest on socially realistic and empirically coherent definitions of social foundation
• Publishing results in peer reviewed journals and presenting at international conferences
• Contributing to C-SOS training activities, workshops, and stakeholder engagement events

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The push to reduce global energy consumption has set a clear trend in modern technology towards devices that are smaller, faster and more energy-efficient. Meeting these demands calls for new materials that can perform several functions at once. Magnetoelectric multiferroics are especially attractive in this respect, because they combine magnetism and ferroelectricity in a single phase. Crucially, this opens the possibility of controlling magnetism with an electric field which could enable entirely new device architectures and transform modern computing and data storage. Despite decades of progress, this promise is hard to realise: in most known multiferroics the two orders only coexist well below room temperature, and many are difficult to integrate with standard semiconductor manufacturing. Turning multiferroics into a practical technology therefore requires identifying or designing new materials that show robust, coupled magnetism and ferroelectricity at room temperature and remain compatible with established fabrication processes.

This is the challenge at the heart of the SMART project funded by the FNR CORE programme and led by Natalya Fedorova. We offer a 2-year postdoc position in which you will use first-principles calculations (DFT) together with analytical modelling to design room-temperature multiferroics via doping of semiconductors. Working mainly with DFT, you will carry out a systematic analysis of electronic, structural, magnetic and ferroelectric properties of these materials - computing, for instance, ground-state magnetic configurations, magnetic exchange interactions, electric polarization and polarization-switching pathways. You will then combine these results with analytical models to describe the magnetoelectric coupling in the most promising candidates and to explore how their magnetism could be manipulated with an applied electric field.

You will join the Modelling of Functional Materials group led by Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) and will benefit from interactions with other team members.

·          Research agent-based simulation of NAV calculation steps, investigating how LLMs can reason reliably over arithmetic-sensitive regulatory workflows and signal confidence levels
·          Experiment with multi-agent orchestration for second-level control workflows, where agents decompose a NAV control task into parallel verification sub-tasks across pricing, accruals, and corporate actions.

System integration (15%):
·          Integrate LLM backends optimised for structured reasoning and develop prompt engineering patterns that enforce step-by-step calculation verification and explainable output

title: PHD IN SPIN PHOTON ENTANGLEMENT GENERATION WITH COLOUR CENTRES IN SILICON CARBIDE (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
PHD IN SPIN PHOTON ENTANGLEMENT GENERATION WITH COLOUR CENTRES IN SILICON CARBIDE (m/f)

Temporary contract | 14+22(+12) months | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
You will be part of the LIST Materials Research and Technology department, where you will carry out your work in the Quantum Materials Group, led by Dr. Florian Kaiser.
Quantum technologies have the potential to revolutionise the world in many aspects. Quantum colour centres in in wide bandgap semiconductors have recently emerged as a promising platform, since they can incorporate quantum systems, which can be scaled up by industrial processing. Along these lines, we have recently shown that individual colour centres can be integrated into silicon carbide nanophotonic waveguides with little-to-no degradation of spin-optical coherences. These finding define the strategy for developing a scalable quantum technology architecture.
Our strategy is to use multiplexed and integrated colour centres for quantum communication tasks. Key here is to generate entanglement between colour centres based on spin-photon entanglement, as well as Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. With this milestone demonstration, we strive to kickstart subsequent developments towards a quantum internet architecture.

The objective of this PhD thesis is to support our work towards optical interference between colour centres, i.e., Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. The initial part of this thesis comprises setting up our new optical cryostat platform, which is based on a combination of standard confocal microscopy, and interferometry. In the second step, you will benefit from our ongoing activities towards quantum photonic silicon carbide chips in which we generate colour centres in fibre-coupled waveguides.
You will determine the ideal pulsed excitation schemes for colour centres, considering spectral, temporal and polarization filtering. Subsequently, you will characterise the photon quality depending on experimental parameters, and implement initial two-photon inteference experiments outside of the cryostat, followed by a fully-on-chip demonstration inside the cryostat. If time permits, this project can be further extended to the generation of entanglement between two colour centre chips located in two different cryostats.

In 2024, LIST and GOODYEAR signed the second phase of their partnership, 2024-2029, building on the outcomes of their previous collaboration and entering new technological areas as well. GOODYEAR-LIST partnership 2.0 embraces Luxembourg's National priorities, such as Sustainability, Digital transformation and Circular economy, through the execution of six Strategic Research Programs: Data Science for Tires, Tire as a Sensor, End-of-Life Tire Valorization, Sustainable Materials for Non-Pneumatic Tires, Sustainable Materials for Next Generation of Pneumatic Tires, Structure-Process-Properties Relationships.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

LIST is seeking to recruit a two-year postdoctoral position to work on fabrication of the piezoelectric energy harvester based on ceramics for tires. This position is part of the Strategic Research Program “Tire as a sensor” in the joint project with Goodyear SA and explores how to transform mechanical energy from tires to a useful electrical energy, which can power tire sensors. The approach used for energy harvesting is the piezoelectric effect. Materials which show piezoelectric properties transform strain variation into electrical charge. These materials can be ceramics or polymers. The material chosen in this study is commercial PZT ceramics. To efficiently use the available mechanical energy in tires and induce strain in the piezoelectric material, it is essential to develop an adapted harvester's design, the transducer. In addition, harvester's signal conditioning plays an important role. To harvest enough electrical energy, all three points: material properties, harvester design and signal conditioning, have to be addressed.

This Postdoc position is mainly focused on development of energy harvester based on ceramics. Several challenges will be addressed to achieve targeted values of power from tires:
·        Investigation of geometries for an efficient transfer of strain from the tire into the ceramic. The design optimisation will be done using finite element modelling (Comsol)
·        Development/adaptation of signal conditioning electronics
·        Integration of the harvester into a real tire
·        Tests in the tire in operation
Other tasks:
·        Conduct literature analysis

title: HR BUSINESS PARTNER (m/f)

HR-26001 HR BUSINESS PARTNER

Permanent contract | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO), bridging scientific excellence and applied research to address real-world challenges. With over 840 employees - more than 70% of whom are researchers, engineers, and PhD-level professionals working across Natural & Built Environments, Industrial Technologies, Space, AI, Security and Defence.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website.

How will you contribute?

Our HR team of 20 professionals covers the full spectrum: HR Administration, Talent Acquisition, Learning and Development, HR Projects, and HR Business Partnering. This last function currently comprises two HRBPs. Following continued organisational growth and increasing complexity, we are creating a third HRBP position - not to replace someone, but because the demand is real.

The role

The HR Business Partner operates with a high degree of autonomy under the general supervision of the HR Director.
This is an individual contributor (IC) role - you will not manage a team, but you will lead by influence, advise with authority, and build lasting relationships within a public research institution.
You will be the primary HR point of contact for a defined population of managers and employees (e.g. Head of Units, Group Leaders, Service Heads), supporting them across the full employment lifecycle — from recruitment validation to exit interviews, from salary review to contractual management. You will work side-by-side with HR Admin, Talent Acquisition, and L&D, but the accountability for your internal "client" perimeter is yours.
This is not a role where you execute a playbook. It is a role where you read the situation, navigate the rules, and find the right path - always within a well-defined legal and regulatory framework.

What you will actually do

Here is what you will spend your time on:

1. Conflict Management & Difficult Situation Advisory

This is the most demanding dimension of the role - not in volume, but in complexity, emotional weight, and reputational stakes. Your approach is fundamentally advisory: you coach managers on how to prevent tensions from escalating, and when a situation has already become critical, you guide them through a structured, legally sound resolution process. You distinguish between what requires immediate intervention and what requires patience. You document carefully, advise precisely, and remain steady when those around you are not. Working with highly educated, articulate professionals means that the people on both sides of a conflict are often skilled at constructing their argument - your job is to remain the clearest, calmest voice in the room.

2. Manager Coaching

You act as a trusted sounding board for managers navigating team dynamics, people decisions, and leadership challenges. This is not change management in the programme-delivery sense - it is the daily, relational work of helping managers think through situations, anticipate consequences, and gradually build their own HR reflex. You build your influence over time, not through authority, but through consistency, credibility, and genuine availability.

3. Recruitment Facilitation & Internal Mobility

You are the HRBP anchor in the recruitment process for your perimeter: framing needs with Hiring Managers, contributing to the annual recruitment plan, and supporting internal mobility decisions. You do not own the end-to-end recruitment process - that is the Talent Acquisition team's remit - but you ensure the right organisational decisions are made at the right moments.

4. Trial Period & Contract Monitoring

You actively track trial periods, flag risks early, and organise structured feedback conversations between managers and employees. You manage end-of-trial-period decisions with rigor and care. You conduct or facilitate exit interviews and ensure that what can be learned is captured. You have a genuine appetite for contractual matters - including the nuances of employment situation.

5. Luxembourg Employment Law - Applied Advisory

You are a reliable reference point on Luxembourg labour law and its practical application: CNS procedures (reclassement, medical visits), parental and family leave frameworks, absence management processes, and dismissal procedures. You do not just cite the rule - you contextualise it, assess the risk level, and give the manager and HRD actionable guidance, always within the legal and regulatory framework.

6. Annual Salary Review

You coordinate and manage the annual salary review cycle for your client perimeter, ensuring internal equity, policy compliance, and a smooth process across managers, HR Admin, and Finance. You are comfortable working with data - building and maintaining Excel dashboards, producing pivot-table-based analyses, and transforming raw data into clear decision-support materials for management. Advisory skills.

7. Performance Management Support

You oversee the annual appraisal cycle and provide advisory support to managers on objective-setting and performance conversations, ensuring process consistency - while remaining in an advisory capacity rather than a direct participant in those discussions.

8. HR Department Contribution

You contribute to collective HR objectives, participate in cross-functional initiatives, and actively represent the HR team's values in every interaction with your internal clients. You communicate through influence - not authority - and you understand that in a public institution, relationships are built slowly and lost quickly.

The Environment

We want you to know what you are signing up for:

Your internal clients are highly educated. Many are PhD-level professionals who are rigorous, analytical, and used to evidence-based reasoning. Vague HR advice will not land. You must be precise, credible, and consistent.
This is a public research institution. That brings strengths - stability, mission-driven colleagues, and genuine intellectual depth - as well as challenges: governance layers and decision cycles that differ from those in smaller organizations.
Flexibility is key. LIST operates across multiple research domains with matrix-like reporting lines and evolving team structures. You will frequently need to act without the full picture being settled.
The tooling is pragmatic, not perfect. Office 365 is your daily environment.
Proactive, not reactive. The best HRBPs here anticipate - they may notice a manager struggling before it becomes a case, they flag a contractual risk before it becomes a dispute. Structured foresight is expected.
You will need to be visible. Open-space team, occasional presence across LIST sites. Being accessible and visible matters here.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Must-haves

At least 5 years of HR experience after Bachelor's degree or 3 years after Master's degree in Human Resources, with a substantial portion in a generalist HRBP or HR advisory role - you have operated independently, ideally not as support to a more senior HRBP
Proven conflict management and employee relations expertise - you have coached managers through difficult situations, both preventively and curatively, from first signal to resolution
Solid knowledge of Luxembourg employment law in practice (CNS, absences, dismissals, parental leave, etc).
Genuine appetite for contractual matters - you find contract drafting, amendment, and employment nuances interesting, not burdensome
Excel proficiency at pivot-table level minimum - you can produce clean, decision-ready reporting and work with compensation or absence data without requiring handholding
Fluency in both English and French (written and spoken) - both languages are in daily use

You will join the Intelligent and Clean Energy Systems (ICES) research unit at the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) and will actively contribute to the WeForming and EnerTEF project, funded by the Horizon Europe, in collaboration with research institutes and Industrial partners around Europe.

WeForming and EnerTEF focus on the use of Inverter-Based Resources (IBRs) in smart grids. In the case of WeForming, this includes the integration of energy storage systems together with smart electric vehicle chargers, while EnerTEF focuses on establishing Testing and Experimentation Facilities (TEFs) for the energy sector. Specifically, this project leverages industrial communication networks, distributed controllers, AI models, and state-of-the-art IBR-based infrastructure to optimize EV charging and energy systems. By integrating distributed energy resources, demand response, and storage, this project aims to enhance grid flexibility and increase the use of renewable energy.

title: Service Desk Agent - (CDI) (m/f)
employer: Mitsubishi UFJ Investor Services & Banking (Luxembourg) S.A.
description:
Tasks and Responsibilities:

Under the supervision of your hierarchical line, you are in charge of the following functions:

• Assure appropriate first-level assistance and timely support to MIBL staff for IT-related incidents, service requests and user issues;
• Provide first-level troubleshooting and resolution for common hardware, software, network, access and workplace IT issues;
• Assure efficient and professional follow-up on Level 1 support activities, ensuring incidents and requests are properly logged, categorized, prioritized and tracked;
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date Service Desk knowledge articles, manuals, support procedures and troubleshooting documentation covering the Bank's IT environment and standard applications;
• Assist in the onboarding, offboarding and modification of user accounts, access rights and IT equipment in accordance with established procedures and security requirements
• Provide appropriate support for the installation, configuration and basic maintenance of standard IT software and hardware equipment within the MIBL premises;
• Ensure proper communication with users regarding the status, progress and resolution of their incidents and service requests;
• Provide first-level support and appropriate escalation during Public Banking Holidays;
• Perform basic monitoring and operational checks of IT services and systems as defined in Level 1 procedures, and promptly escalate any anomalies to Level 2 support;
• Escalate unresolved or complex incidents and service requests to Level 2 support or other appropriate IT teams, ensuring that all relevant troubleshooting information and actions already performed are properly documented;
• Immediately report suspected IT security incidents, phishing attempts, malware, unauthorized access or other security concerns to the appropriate IT/Information Security contact;


Your Profile:

• Good knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365 and standard end-user applications;
• Good knowledge of PC hardware, peripherals and basic network troubleshooting;
• Good knowledge of Active Directory and basic user/access management;
• Good knowledge of ITIL / IT Service Management and ITSM ticketing tools;
• Good knowledge of basic IT security principles;
• Good knowledge of Banking applications and IT support procedures;

Salary Range: 58k – 61k


Please be aware that in accordance with the law of July 23rd, 2016 the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3).

Lead supplier selection and commercial strategy

Align business requirements with Vodafone's global category strategies.

Manage supplier relationships across the full contract lifecycle.
Ensure contractual compliance, performance management and risk mitigation.
Monitor supplier KPIs and minimise value leakage through robust contract management.
Act as a strategic business partner

Serve as the key interface between SCM and Vodafone Business stakeholders.
Build strong, credible relationships with internal functions and account teams.
Influence demand, challenge requirements and drive demand management excellence.
Contribute to category strategy and market insight

Support global category strategies, sourcing decisions and supplier roadmaps.
Provide insight on market dynamics, supplier ecosystems and commercial models.
Contribute to product, partner and alliance roadmaps.
Support revenue growth and customer delivery

Support delivery of global enterprise solutions with compliant and competitive supplier contracts.
Ensure alignment with revenue growth, customer experience and margin objectives.
Leverage tools, governance and innovation

Use BI and procurement tools, such as SAP and AVA, to identify opportunities and track performance.
Apply Design-to-Cost and global sourcing initiatives.
Drive SCM governance, programme assurance and benefits tracking.
Work agile and collaboratively

Operate across a global matrix organisation.
Lead and participate in cross-functional and cross-category initiatives.
Collaborate effectively across regions using digital tools.

Business Partnering: Build strong stakeholder relationships to drive performance and value
Commercial Contract Management: Protect Vodafone's interests and ensure contractual value delivery
Demand Optimisation: Analyse and influence demand in line with strategy and budgets
Procurement Negotiation: Deliver optimal outcomes through effective negotiation
Market Insight & Strategy: Apply industry knowledge to support sourcing and category strategy

Minimum of 3 years' procurement experience
Strong communication, analytical and conceptual thinking skills

title: Supply Chain Environment Specialist (m/f)
description:
At Vodafone, we're working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

With us, you can be truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
Join Us

At Vodafone, we're not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we're shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you're part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.
What you'll do

The Supply Chain Environmental Specialist supports the development and delivery of Vodafone's environmental strategy across supply chain categories and markets. The role focuses on category-level climate transition planning, supplier engagement, emissions reduction, and capability building within procurement, ensuring purchased goods and services align with Vodafone's 2030 reduction milestones and 2040 Net Zero ambition.
The role sits within Vodafone Procure & Connect (VP&C) in Luxembourg and reports into Vodafone Group's Sustainable Business Team, which sets global sustainability strategy and partners with business units to drive delivery. This is a growing and high-impact area, offering the opportunity to work with sustainability and supply chain experts while engaging a wide range of stakeholders across markets and functions. The role requires a self-driven individual with strong communication and programme management skills, comfortable creating new ways of working.

1. Category climate transition strategies

Support the development of category-specific climate transition plans aligned to Net Zero 2040.
Conduct baseline assessments to identify emissions hotspots, risks, opportunities, and KPIs.
Embed environmental criteria into category planning to support long-term decarbonisation.

2. Procurement collaboration & decision-making support

Support the implementation of sustainable procurement processes, including environmental requirements and contract terms.
Partner with category managers to embed carbon reduction targets, environmental KPIs, and climate-aligned supplier selection.
Provide climate data, insights, and analysis to support responsible sourcing decisions.
Support ESG assessments within RFQs, guiding suppliers and integrating results into scoring models.

3. Supplier engagement & performance management

Manage supplier performance against ESG contractual commitments and KPIs.
Drive supplier alignment with Vodafone's environmental targets, reporting, and transition pathways.
Issue and track supplier improvement plans, escalating risks where required.
Participate in supplier reviews to support credible decarbonisation and improved environmental performance.

4. Capability building for procurement teams

Deliver training, tools, and guidance to strengthen environmental capability across procurement.
Develop templates, guidance, and onboarding materials covering KPIs, carbon methodologies, and assessments.
Facilitate workshops and learning sessions to embed sustainability into BAU procurement activities.

5. Environmental data, reporting & governance

Support consolidation and validation of supplier climate data for category strategies, CSRD, and internal reporting.
Maintain category-level environmental KPIs and provide progress updates to leadership.
Provide accurate and timely supply chain environmental data to Group Finance.
Who you are

    Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business, Logistics, Sustainability, or a related field. A Master's degree is an advantage.
    4+ years of experience in supply chain, procurement, sourcing, supplier management, logistics, or a related discipline, with exposure to complex stakeholder environments and cross-functional collaboration.
    Strong project management and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, interpret complex data sets, identify risks, and drive informed decision-making.
    Experience engaging and influencing suppliers and internal stakeholders, including Procurement, Finance, Operations, and Sustainability teams, to deliver business and sustainability objectives.
    Demonstrated ability to support supplier negotiations, supplier performance management, and risk mitigation initiatives, leveraging data-driven insights to improve outcomes.
    Strong understanding of procurement processes, category management, sourcing strategies, contract compliance, and supplier engagement practices.
    Proven track record of identifying and implementing process improvements, standardisation initiatives, and operational efficiencies within supply chain or procurement functions.
    Proactive, collaborative, and highly detail-oriented approach to problem-solving, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
    Knowledge of supply chain sustainability principles, including circular economy, reverse logistics, responsible sourcing, ESG considerations, and supplier sustainability programmes.
    Passion for environmental sustainability, climate transition, Scope 3 emissions reduction, supplier ESG performance management, and circularity initiatives.
    Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools. Experience with ERP/MRP systems, reporting tools, and process automation is highly desirable.

Not a perfect fit?

Worried that you don't meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity.
What's in it for you

We want you to feel happy and fulfilled at work, without compromising the other things in life that matter to you. Here are some of the ways we support this:
Annual Discretionary Bonus
•    Rewarding your hard work and dedication
Generous Annual Leave
•    28 days of annual leave, with the option to buy an additional 5 days and the opportunity to carry over 5 days per year
•    1 additional day (Family Day) for personal milestones or special occasions
•    11 public holidays to enjoy time with family and friends
•    5 charity days per year to give back to the community
Flexible Work Arrangements
•    Flexible working schedule to help you balance your professional and personal life
•    20 days to work from abroad, allowing you to combine work with travel and new experiences
Comprehensive Health and Wellness
•    Lunch vouchers to support your midday meals
•    Access to private AXA health insurance and a robust pension scheme to secure your health and future
Continuous Learning and Development
•    Access to Vodafone University and online training resources to help you grow your skills and advance your career

title: Chef de Rang (m/f)
description:
Description:

Fiche de poste

Responsable d'un rang, c'est-à-dire d'un groupe de tables, le chef de rang doit veiller au bon déroulement du service sur l'ensemble de ces tables.

En cas d'absence du maître d'hôtel prise de commande le chef de rang fait le service à table et débarrassé aidé par des commis.

Lors de la mise en place des tables, il vérifie que rien ne manque; au moment du service, il doit parfaitement bien connaître la carte et les plats pour être en mesure de répondre aux questions des clients, connaître, maîtriser toutes les techniques de présentation et de découpage, voire de flambage.

À la fin du repas, il s'assure de la satisfaction des clients, effectue l'addition et encaisse leur règlement.

Activités principales

• Assurer un excellent service
• Relations avec la clientèle
• Mise en place
• Accueil et accompagnement du client
• Prise de commande et service
• Encadrer le travail des commis

Coordination et contrôle

• effectuer la mise en place des tables avant chaque service,
• vérifier la propreté et l'intégrité de la vaisselle et des couverts,
• mettre en place les consoles de service,
• accueillir et accompagner le client jusqu'à sa table,
• présenter la carte et la carte des vins (en cas d'absence du sommelier)
• prendre la commande et la transmettre à la cuisine,
• connaître parfaitement les plats à la carte ainsi que les éventuels plats du jour,
• expliquer aux clients la composition des plats au moment du service,
• répondre aux questions des clients,
• maîtriser les différentes techniques de découpage et de présentation,
• adapter le service à table en fonction du travail des cuisiniers,
• vérifier le bon déroulement du service,
• encadrer le travail des commis de salle et des serveurs,
• s'enquérir de la satisfaction du client au cours et à la fin du repas,
• éditer l'addition,
• réaliser l'encaissement,
• débarrasser les tables.

Compétences principales

• Analyser rapidement le besoin du client et le conseiller dans ses choix
• Gérer les réclamations et les remarques négatives
• Adopter les gestes et postures permettant de travailler en toute sécurité
• Placer le client au centre de son activité et de sa mission
• Connaissance d'une à plusieurs langues étrangères

Savoir Etre

• Accueillir les clients avec une excellente maîtrise des gestes, de l'expression du visage et du langage
• Adapter son comportement, sa présentation générale à l'image et à la culture de l'établissement
• Assurer la cohésion de l'équipe
• Faire reconnaître et accepter son autorité
• Installer dès la réservation un climat de convivialité en appliquant les codes de l'établissement
• Relever les dysfonctionnements de service et en parler hors présence client

description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Finance Business Partner (Business Services) based in Luxembourg (hybrid). You will partner with Business Services leadership to drive lean accounting, process optimization and AI-driven reporting, lead budgeting and forecasting cycles, and deliver actionable financial insights that improve performance. The role suits a senior, pragmatic finance professional (10+ years) with SAP and BI experience, a strong process orientation, and a proven ability to deliver under pressure.

As Senior Finance Business Partner (Business Services) you will be the finance lead embedded with Business Services, acting as a change agent to drive lean accounting, process optimization and data-driven decision making. You will tightly partner with COO (Head of Business Services) and the business services leaders to translate operational needs into actionable financial insights, streamline processes through automation and AI-enabled tools, and support performance improvement across cost, quality and delivery. This replacement role requires a senior, hands-on professional who thrives under pressure, prioritizes effectively, and contributes as a collaborative team player.

What you will be working on

• Act as the trusted finance partner to CFO, Head of Finance, COO and Business Services leadership: deliver financial insight, challenge assumptions and influence decisions.
• Act as a sparring partner to the Director of FP&A contributing to robust discussions on financial performance, forecasting assumptions, business plans, controlling model and strategic priorities.
• Lead process improvement and lean accounting initiatives to simplify workflows, reduce waste and strengthen internal controls.
• Design, develop and maintain reporting and analysis that support operational decisions — move towards near real-time, KPI-driven dashboards.
• Drive automation and AI adoption across finance processes (reporting, forecasting, reconciliations, controls), identifying opportunities for AI.
• Support monthly close activities and ensure accuracy and timeliness of financial data.
• Lead budgeting, forecasting and budgetary control processes for Business Services; provide scenario analysis and actionable recommendations.
• Translate business change needs into finance requirements and support implementation of new tools, systems or processes (working closely with Digital Accelerator team  and Finance peers).
• Deliver ad hoc financial analysis and sponsor small-to-medium projects that enhance financial performance or operating model.
• Promote financial and business awareness across the Business function and within Finance through coaching and clear communication.

What we look for

• Strong accounting and controlling background with a minimum of 10 years' relevant experience.
• Advanced Excel; experience with SAP finance modules and Reporting tools.
• Hands-on familiarity with automation/AI tools or demonstrable appetite and experience driving such initiatives.
• Solid budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling skills.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; other languages an asset.
• Proven track record in a finance business partnering role supporting shared services, central functions or similar.
• Demonstrable experience running process improvement projects and delivering automation/AI-driven efficiencies.
• Comfortable operating independently, handling ambiguous situations and escalating appropriately.
• Behavioral skills and competencies: growth mindset, change agent, process-oriented, detail focused, pressure management, team work, decision quality and uphold KPMG firm standars.
• Professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CPA, CFA or equivalent) and experience in professional services or the Big Four environment as an asset.

title: Kundeservice søges til Malta - Betalt relokation
description:
Kundeservice søges til Malta – God løn, bonus og relocation-pakke

Kunne du tænke dig at kombinere en international karriere med livet på Malta?

Vi søger lige nu en dansktalende Kundeservice til en langsigtet stilling hos en international bank på Malta.

Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor du arbejder med danske kunder og får mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for kundeservice, salg og den finansielle sektor.

Stillingen er særligt interessant for dig, der allerede har erfaring med kundeservice eller salg – og måske har erfaring som Team Leader eller med KPI'er og dataanalyse.

OM JOBBET

Som Kundeservice bliver du en del af et team, der håndterer kundeservice, onboarding, salg og betalinger.

Du vil blandt andet:

• Besvare kundehenvendelser via telefon, live chat, email og SMS

• Hjælpe kunder med information om bankens produkter, services og betalinger

• Håndtere spørgsmål og henvendelser fra danske kunder

• Arbejde tæt sammen med betalings- og collectionsafdelingen

• Følge gældende procedurer, regler og lovgivning

• Arbejde med salg og aktivt identificere relevante salgsmuligheder

• Sikre en professionel og effektiv kundeoplevelse

Du refererer direkte til den danske Team Leader og bliver en del af et internationalt arbejdsmiljø.

HVORFOR MALTA?

Malta er en populær destination for danskere, der ønsker at kombinere arbejde med livet i udlandet.

Her får du mulighed for at bo på en middelhavsø med et internationalt miljø, gode strande, restauranter, et aktivt socialt liv og masser af muligheder for at opleve øen.

Virksomheden arrangerer blandt andet ugentlige Friday Drinks og forskellige sociale arrangementer, hvor du kan lære dine kollegaer og Malta bedre at kende.

HVAD FÅR DU?

✈️ Op til €1.000 i relocation-refusion til kandidater, der flytter til Malta

Refusionen kan blandt andet bruges til fly, taxi og dokumenterede udgifter i forbindelse med flytningen

God Løn

10% bonus udbetalt kvartalsvist

Mulighed for yderligere bonus efter 6 måneders ansættelse

️ 24 feriedage + 14 helligdage

Health & Life Insurance efter 6 måneders prøvetid

Gratis frugt, brød og morgenmadsprodukter på arbejdspladsen

Friday Drinks og andre sociale arrangementer

Gode muligheder for intern udvikling – både til andre afdelinger og management

Langsigtet kontrakt

HVEM ER DU?

Vi leder efter dig, der:

• Har gode engelskkundskaber både skriftligt og mundtligt

• Har erfaring fra kundeservice eller salg

• Er vant til at arbejde med KPI'er og data

• Er engageret, professionel og ansvarsbevidst

• Kan arbejde struktureret og følge procedurer

• Er god til at kommunikere med kunder og kollegaer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra kundeservice, salg eller den finansielle sektor, men det vigtigste er, at du er engageret, professionel og pålidelig.

PRAKTISK INFORMATION

Malta – Msida

Fuldtid

40 timer om ugen

Langsigtet kontrakt

1 dags oplæring

6 måneders prøvetid

Opfølgende reviews efter 1, 3 og 6 måneder

Hvis du gerne vil tage næste skridt i din karriere, samtidig med at du får mulighed for at bo og arbejde på Malta, er dette en spændende mulighed.

Der er en ledig stilling.

Ansøg allerede i dag.
Mathias@jobsqd.com

title: Kundenservice / Online Presenter (Koreanisch & Englisch) – Malta (Kundendienstberater/in)
description:
Für einen internationalen Technologie- und Entertainment-Kunden in Malta suchen wir koreanischsprachige Kandidaten für eine kundenorientierte Online-Rolle in einem professionellen Studio-Umfeld.
Vorerfahrung ist nicht erforderlich – eine umfassende Schulung wird angeboten.

We are recruiting Korean-speaking Online Presenters / Customer Service Representatives for a global technology company based in Malta.

In this role, you will work from a professional studio environment, engaging with online users and delivering a high-quality, interactive digital experience. No previous experience is required — full training is provided.

Key Responsibilities

- Host and present interactive online sessions from a live studio
- Engage with users in a professional, friendly, and customer-focused manner
- Maintain high presentation and service standards at all times
- Participate in internal initiatives and promotional activities
- Follow company procedures and quality standards
- Report any operational or technical issues to supervisors
- Maintain a clean and professional working environment

Requirements

- No previous experience required – full training provided
- Fluent Korean
- Conversational English (B1 or above)
- Willingness to work a 24/7 rotating shift pattern (including weekends and public holidays)
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Comfortable working in a multicultural, international environment

Benefits

- Competitive salary
- Up to €400 monthly performance bonus
- €400 annual wellness allowance
- Night shift allowance
- Monthly transport allowance (€70)
- Monthly food allowance
- Retention allowance
- Life insurance (2x annual salary)
- Private health insurance from day one
- Free access to on-site gym
- Company events and social activities
- Snacks and fruit provided at the workplace

Note: German language skills are not required. Relocation to Malta is supported.

title: Kundenbetreuer (m/w/d) – Umzug nach Malta ( Umzugspaket inklusive ) (Berufsspezialist/in - Vertrieb)
description:
Als deutschsprachiger Kundenbetreuer (Customer Account Advisor) bist du Teil eines europäischen Kundenserviceteams und unterstützt internationale Kundinnen und Kunden direkt von unserem Büro im sonnigen Malta aus.

Du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für eine Vielzahl von Anfragen rund um Kundenkonten und sorgst für ein positives Serviceerlebnis.

Diese Position wird in Vollzeit angeboten und erfordert flexible Arbeitszeiten. Um dem vollen Sportkalender gerecht zu werden, arbeitest du im Schichtsystem an fünf von sieben Tagen – Wochenend- und Feiertagsarbeit ist regelmäßig vorgesehen.

Die Stelle ist Teil eines hybriden Arbeitsmodells – du arbeitest sowohl von zu Hause als auch im modernen Büro im Zentrum von Sliema, mit Meerblick und Zugang zu zahlreichen Freizeitmöglichkeiten.

Was wir bieten

- Vollständiges Umzugspaket (Details unten)
- Attraktives Jahresbruttogehalt von ca. 34.600 €
- Gehaltszuschläge abhängig von Arbeitszeiten
- Lebens- und Krankenversicherung
- Kostenlose Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft
- Zusätzliche 5 % deines Bruttojahresgehalts als Altersvorsorge
- Hybrides Arbeitsmodell (Homeoffice + Büro)
- Umfassende Einarbeitung und kontinuierliches Coaching
- Interne Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten

Relocation-Paket

- 6 Wochen kostenlose Unterkunft bei Ankunft
- Rückerstattung des Flugtickets (bis zu 285 €)
- 800 € monatlicher Wohnzuschuss in den ersten 6 Monaten
- Zusätzlich 100 € monatlich in den ersten 6 Monaten für Heimflüge

Deine Aufgaben

- Kundenbetreuung via Live-Chat und E-Mail
- Bearbeitung von Anfragen zu Zahlungen, Verifizierung, technischen Themen und allgemeinen Kontofragen
- Eskalation komplexer Fälle an Fachabteilungen
- Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams zur effizienten Problemlösung

Was du mitbringst

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse
- Gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2)
- Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung
- Lösungsorientiertes Denken
- Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit, inklusive Wochenenden

Bereit für deinen Karrierestart unter der Sonne?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem englischen Lebenslauf – wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

You are a sparring partner for managers and support them with various HR issues, such as performance, absenteeism, and development.
