title: ENGINEERING MANAGER TILL XENERGIC
description:
What does it take to turn advanced semiconductor technology into products ready for customers and production? At Xenergic, it takes strong engineering, close collaboration and the ability to bring different technical disciplines together. We are now looking for an Engineering Manager to lead that work and develop our engineering organisation as we grow.

YOU WILL

Xenergic is a Lund-based semiconductor company developing high-speed, On-chip memory IP for advanced chip technologies. Our engineering teams work across several technical disciplines, developing technology that spans from transistor-level design to customer integration and mass production.

As Engineering Manager, you will lead Xenergic’s engineering organisation and take overall responsibility for product development and delivery. Working closely with the CEO, CTO and Business Development & Sales Manager, you will bring together technical direction, people and execution, ensuring that teams have the right priorities, resources and conditions to deliver.

This is a role for someone who wants to lead without losing touch with the technology. You will work across analog and digital design, software and verification, bringing different engineering disciplines together and creating the structure needed to turn advanced technology into reliable products and customer solutions.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

    

Lead and develop the engineering organisation across analog, digital, software and verification.

    

Take overall responsibility for product development and delivery, including resources, priorities, timelines and budgets.

    

Develop engineering processes, design methodologies and ways of working that support quality and efficient development.

    

Develop the team and its capabilities while creating clarity, collaboration and accountability across the organisation.

    

Ensure effective communication and documentation throughout product development and with relevant internal and external stakeholders.

The role reports to the CEO and is part of the management team. It is a full-time position based in Lund.

YOU ARE

Your career has given you a strong technical foundation and experience in complex product development within semiconductors, electronics or another relevant technology environment. Over time, you have taken on broader responsibility and moved towards leading people, teams and technical delivery.

A technical university degree in electronics or a related field provides a strong foundation for the role. Equivalent technical experience may also be considered. Experience in the semiconductor industry is particularly valuable, especially within areas such as memory, chip design, verification, chip validation or silicon bring-up.

You have experience leading engineers and understand how to create the right conditions for highly skilled specialists to do their best work. You are comfortable setting priorities, making decisions and taking responsibility for delivery when several teams and technical disciplines need to work together.

As a leader, you are pragmatic and solution-oriented. You stay close enough to the technology to understand the challenges, ask the right questions and support your teams, without needing to be the expert in every technical detail. You bring structure when needed, while giving experienced engineers the trust and space to solve complex problems. Fluency in English is required.

At Xenergic, you will join a highly specialised engineering environment where technology and product development are closely connected. Short decision paths allow you to influence how the engineering organisation develops and how we take our technology from development to customer integration and production.

WANT TO KNOW MORE?

In this recruitment, Xenergic is collaborating with Nexer Recruit. Applications are reviewed continuously, so please submit your application as soon as possible. For questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact recruitment consultant Johanna Värmfors at johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com or +46 730 821 230, or Artan Bitiqi at artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com or +46 723 61 28 44.

We look forward to hearing from you.

ABOUT XENERGIC

Xenergic is a Swedish semiconductor technology company based in Lund, developing high-speed, On-chip memory IP for advanced semiconductor applications.

Its technology addresses important challenges in modern chip design, where performance, power consumption and silicon area are becoming increasingly important. Xenergic’s solutions are relevant for applications ranging from IoT and mobile devices to networking, high-performance computing and AI.  Xenergic combines deep semiconductor expertise with a specialised engineering organisation and an international market. As we continue to develop our technology and products, joining Xenergic means becoming part of a small technology company where your work and ideas can have a real impact.

title: Security Services Analyst
description:
Thale’s Security Analyst Team is tasked with tackling and solving our most complex field issues for enterprise customers. As a Security Analyst, you will be analyzing large amounts of traffic to websites to find correlations and patterns. Based on the conclusions drawn from the analysis, the analyst collaborates with the customer and with Thales’s[SL1]  internal teams to implement mitigation strategies to stop automated website attacks.

An important part of the position is to work with clients, investigate anomalies, and provide easily consumable but detailed evidence for all actions taken. A degree of flexibility to take appointments evenings and mornings required.

ABOUT THE TEAM:

We’re part of a global team operating on a follow-the-sun model, so although we cover all time zones, you’ll be working with the EMEA region.

Most of the team is based in Belfast, UK, with one analyst currently in the Sveavägen, Stockholm office; this is a hybrid position with on-site required during the training period.

WHAT WE OFFER:

●          Competitive compensation package including base salary and performance-based incentives.

●          A key role in shaping the company’s presence in a strategically important region.

●          Opportunity to work with innovative technologies and cross-border teams.

●          Professional development, training, and career advancement opportunities.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

●       Become a Thales Expert - you will know everything there is to know about how Thales’s platform works, as well as how bots and bot operators attack websites

●       Monitor our internal queue and provide incident response in line with the respective premium SLA

●       Analyze false positives for detection mechanisms to hone the product

●       Spend time analyzing web traffic data to identify and isolate new advanced bot behaviors

●       Work with Thales’s customers to fully understand the issues automated attacks cause to their business and devise strategies to mitigate or eliminate the issues

●       Have regular calls with customers to discuss findings and analysis

●       Work with Thales’s internal research, data science, and product teams by delivering actionable intelligence that will inform future product enhancements

●       Use data visualization tools to create consumable reports to quickly validate findings and demonstrate the efficacy of actions taken

●       Be a trusted advisor, take ownership of all problems you encounter, and be a team player

REQUIREMENTS:

●       You have an interest in security/technology and keep up with the latest trends and news

●       You love solving difficult problems and finding the needle in the haystack

●       You have meticulous communication skills and are confident in your ability to have regular technical and non-technical calls

●       Your customer facing skills are polished and you know not to guess when in doubt

●       You have intermediate to advanced SQL skills

●       You have experience with data visualization tools like Tableau or Looker

●       You understand the basics of scripting and have experience in one or more languages such as Python, Bash, or Go.

●       You have HTTP network knowledge and can describe in some detail how websites are delivered to browsers

●       You are a leader and can work independently as well as tightly with a team

●       You have a Bachelor’s degree in IT/Mathematics/Engineering/Computer or equivalent demonstrated success

●       Fluent in Swedish and English.

The position requires that you undergo and be approved in accordance with the applicable regulations for security protection. For positions where Thales has requirements for security clearance, this may entail a requirement for local citizenship.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
VX Fiber is looking for Senior Full Stack Developers to build our SaaS platform for fibre network operations. This is not a role for someone who wants to sit at the end of a requirements pipeline and turn tickets into code. We are looking for developers who want to understand the problem, shape the solution, and use both traditional engineering and agentic coding tools to take ideas all the way into production.

What you will do

Own problems from unclear requirement to production. Help define the use case, work out what should be built, propose the technical approach, implement it, verify that it works, and follow it in production.

Our product teams are split between OSS and BSS+, with the work regularly crossing service and team boundaries.

The problems are specific, but the rules and dependencies around them can get complicated. An edge-site outage may require us to work out which ISPs are affected from network topology, while accounting for subscribers on redundant paths. An ISP expanding into a new city may sell subscriptions before the handover exists, then need those subscriptions to activate automatically once the network is ready.

You will:

    Clarify requirements with Product and Design, working directly with engineers and domain experts.
    Design services and data models. Propose architectural changes for Staff Engineers and Architects to review.
    Build mainly backend software, while being comfortable enough in the frontend to own a feature across the stack.
    Design tests around failure modes. Cover retries, bad data and unavailable dependencies.
    Treat operability and developer experience as part of feature development. Use logs, metrics and traces to understand production behaviour, and work with the Platform team to improve deployment, local development and feedback loops.
    Work hands-on with agents and harnesses, including context orchestration and agentic pipelines.
    Improve the team through reviews, mentoring and technical discussion.

Our backend is mostly Go, with Protobuf and gRPC between services. GraphQL sits between those services and a React/TypeScript frontend. Postgres is our direction of travel, with some Mongo legacy. Temporal handles workflows. Our application platform uses Nomad, Consul and Vault on AWS, deployed in Europe and South Africa. Experience with any of the above are not a requirement.

What we look for

We care about whether you perform at a senior level. Years of experience and formal degrees are not criteria.

A senior developer here should be able to take an unclear problem, create enough structure to move forward, and deliver software that works in production.

Experience we value:

    Strong backend engineering experience in any language.
    Shipped and operated SaaS products as part of a product team.
    Broad systems design skills and good data design judgement. Be able to make architectural proposals and discuss trade-offs.
    Practical experience with testing and failure modes, plus observability in production.
    Hands-on experience with modern agentic development, including harnesses and context orchestration.

Telecom experience weighs heavily. Experience with OSS/BSS or network automation is valuable, as is fibre or wholesale telecom knowledge. It is not a hard requirement.

Good taste matters. Know when complexity is justified, when an abstraction helps, and when it gets in the way. You are familiar with DDD, KISS, 12 factor apps and similar frameworks/patterns, and can reason about their merits and drawbacks. Care about APIs, data models and maintainability, and know when the best decision is to build nothing.

People who do well here take ownership, make good calls with incomplete information, and make other engineers better.

What we offer

At VX Fiber, you get the opportunity to work on technology that supports the future of digital infrastructure. Our vision is to enable digital freedom for individuals, businesses, and communities, and our platform is designed to be flexible, stable, scalable, and built for transformation.

We offer:

    Meaningful work — contribute to digital infrastructure used across markets.
    Real technical problems — work with systems that need to scale, integrate, and operate reliably.
    Modern technologies — build with a stack that includes Go, gRPC, Temporal, GraphQL, LLMs, and cloud-native tooling.
    Ownership and autonomy — take responsibility for your work and help shape how things are done.
    Growth — learn from experienced colleagues and grow into larger technical responsibilities.
    International context — work with colleagues, customers, and networks across several countries.
    Collaboration — we build, learn, and improve together.

Our values are simple: work smart, take ownership, win together, and make impact.

About the employment

Type: Permanent, full-time role

Location: Umeå, on-site

Language: Fluent English, spoken and written required. Swedish is spoken in the office.

Why VX Fiber?

VX Fiber is a Swedish technology company with over 20 years of global experience in fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) and open access networks. Our goal is to create digital freedom for individuals, businesses, and communities by offering reliable, scalable, and sustainable network solutions. Our business combines software, infrastructure, operations, and connectivity, which means our developers work close to real-world systems and customer problems.

Our platform supports areas such as OSS/BSS, provisioning, service activation, network inventory, ISP onboarding, marketplace flows, subscriber services, monitoring, and automation.

We connect network owners, service providers, and end-users through an open access model that accelerates time to market, reduces cost, and automates complexity. With proven flexibility and fast onboarding, our technology supports sustainable, future-ready networks.

VX Fiber — Made to transform. Scalable by design.

title: Operations Manager

Our performance-orientated environment motivates employees to think differently and embrace challenges so we can continue improving lives, every day through better hygiene and health. We provide a sustainable work-life based on flexibility for both employees and employers. We are committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion in everything we do. It is the key to our success in creating an inclusive, collaborative, and caring company culture where you can be you with us. Our purpose of Breaking Barriers to Well-being, enables customers and consumers to lead fuller lives at all stages of life. Our leading global brands include TENA and Tork, and other strong brands such as Actimove, Cutimed, JOBST, Knix, Leukoplast, Libero, Libresse, Lotus, Modibodi, Nosotras, Saba, Tempo, TOM Organic and Zewa are sold in 150 countries. I In 2024, Essity had net sales of approximately SEK 146bn (EUR 13bn) and employed 36,000 people. We are headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden and Essity is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. If you want to join a company where dedication to people is powered by innovation, welcome to Essity!

At Essity, we're committed to improving well-being through leading hygiene and health solutions. At our manufacturing site in Askersund, we produce advanced wound care products under the Sorbact and Cutimed brands, supporting healthcare professionals and patients around the world.

We are now looking for an experienced Operations Manager to join our site leadership team and play a key role in shaping the future of one of the most strategically important product areas within our Health & Medical business. This is an opportunity to lead operational excellence, drive cultural transformation, and make a lasting impact on a site that continues to receive significant investment and attention within Essity's global manufacturing network.

About the Role

As Operations Manager, you will be responsible for leading the manufacturing organization and ensuring outstanding performance across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost and People.

You will lead a team consisting of 2 Department Leaders and one Maintenance Leader, with overall responsibility for approximately 60 employees at the Askersund site. As a member of the Site Leadership Team, you will work closely with colleagues across Quality, Logistics, HR, Finance, Projects and EHS to deliver business results while developing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement and employee engagement.

This role is critical to the site's ongoing development and transformation journey. You will have the opportunity to strengthen manufacturing excellence, improve productivity, increase equipment efficiency, reduce losses and waste, and further develop a high-performing organization capable of meeting future business demands.

Key Responsibilities

    

Lead and develop the Operations organization, including Production and Maintenance

    

Deliver performance across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost and People

    

Drive manufacturing excellence and continuous improvement initiatives

    

Create clear targets, accountability and performance follow-up throughout the organization

    

Improve productivity, equipment efficiency and waste reduction

    

Build a culture of engagement, ownership and continuous learning

    

Ensure compliance with quality, regulatory and operational requirements

    

Contribute actively as a member of the Site Leadership Team

    

Manage operational budgets and drive sustainable business results

    

Partner with stakeholders across the site and the wider Essity manufacturing network

Who You Are

You are a strong operational leader who combines a structured approach to manufacturing performance with an engaging and empowering leadership style.

You know how to create results through others by setting clear expectations, building accountability and developing leaders and teams. You have experience driving change and understand that sustainable operational improvements require both robust systems and strong people engagement.

You bring energy, urgency and a hands-on approach to solving challenges while maintaining a long-term perspective on organizational development.

We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

    

Several years of experience in a senior manufacturing or operations leadership role

    

Experience leading managers and larger operational organizations

    

Proven success in driving operational performance and continuous improvement

    

Strong knowledge of Manufacturing Excellence, TPM, World Class Manufacturing or similar operational frameworks

    

Experience from high-volume manufacturing environments

    

Background from FMCG, food production, process industry, consumer goods or similar industries is highly valued

    

Experience managing budgets and business performance

    

Strong stakeholder management and change leadership skills

    

Fluent English, both written and spoken

    

We welcome candidates who are fluent in Swedish as well as international candidates. If you do not currently speak Swedish, we expect a strong interest in learning the language and becoming comfortable communicating in a Swedish-speaking work environment.

It is considered an advantage if you also have

    

Experience from regulated manufacturing environments, such as medical devices, healthcare products or pharmaceuticals

    

Experience leading organizations through transformation and cultural change

title: Health and Safety manager
description:

I rollen arbetar du både operativt och förebyggande med arbetsmiljö- och säkerhetsfrågor. Du följer upp att gällande säkerhetsrutiner, lagkrav och projektbestämmelser efterlevs och samarbetar nära med projektledning, arbetsledning, entreprenörer och övrig personal på arbetsplatsen.

In this role, you will be responsible for both operational and preventive health and safety activities. You will work closely with project management, site management, contractors and other personnel on site.

We are looking for a responsible, communicative and confident professional who works in a structured manner and maintains a visible presence on site. You should have the ability to engage with personnel at all levels and promote a high level of safety awareness throughout the project.

title: Crewing Workforce Optimisation Lead
description:
Location - Any active Stena Line office across the Irish Sea, Scandinavia and Baltic region.

What if your insights could influence how thousands of colleagues work and succeed across an international business?

You'll join a collaborative and forward-thinking team that is helping shape the future of crewing at Stena Line. Working across People, Crewing, Operations and Finance, you'll partner with senior leaders and key stakeholders to influence decisions that support both our people and our business goals.

This is a role with genuine variety and visibility. One day you may be developing workforce models and analysing future demand, the next you'll be presenting recommendations to leadership teams or supporting transformation projects that impact colleagues across the organisation.

You'll have the opportunity to challenge existing ways of working, introduce new ideas and help build a more data-driven approach to workforce planning. Most importantly, you'll be part of a culture where collaboration, continuous improvement and personal development are encouraged every day.

Benefits

At Stena Line, we recognise the importance of supporting our employees both professionally and personally. As part of our team, you'll have access to a range of benefits including:

    Opportunities for learning, development and career progression
    Health and wellbeing support

    The opportunity to work across international teams and contribute to strategic business improvements
    A competitive reward package relevant to your local market

Please note that specific benefits may vary depending on your location and employing entity. Full details of the benefits package applicable to your region will be shared with shortlisted candidates during the recruitment process.

Who you are

At Stena Line your personality matters as much as how good you are at what you do. Regardless of your role, our behaviours welcoming, caring and reliable guides you in your everyday work and the challenges you face.

You are curious, analytical and enjoy using data to solve problems and influence business decisions. You combine strategic thinking with a practical mindset and thrive in a fast-paced environment. Confident in collaborating with stakeholders at all levels, you take a proactive approach, navigate ambiguity with ease and are passionate about turning insights into action.

Qualifications

    Significant experience in strategic workforce planning within a complex organisation
    Strong knowledge of workforce planning methodologies, forecasting and scenario modelling
    Experience using workforce data and analytics to support business decision making
    Knowledge of maritime and labour legislation and its application within workforce planning activities
    Advanced Excel skills and experience using Power BI or similar business intelligence tools
    Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills

Interested?

This is a full-time, permanent opportunity, with the successful candidate able to work from any active Stena Line office location across our Irish Sea, Scandinavia or Baltics region.

As a leader in sustainable shipping, Stena Line has Europe’s most comprehensive route network focusing on transportation of both passengers and freight. We have over 8,750 employees in our Stena Line family across Scandinavia, around the UK, the North Sea and the Baltics, all actively support the daily business.

Our purpose is to be a trusted link between people, places and societies. We play a vital role in keeping everything connected. We make sure people and goods arrive where they need to be, enabling business to thrive and societies to grow. We connect family and friends, and make it possible to explore new destinations or revisit favourite places.

We are committed to maintaining and developing a sustainable working environment, free from harassment, that gives equal opportunities to everyone. We embrace equality, diversity and inclusion and welcome all applicants.

title: Lead Project Leader - AI Governance & Technology Enablers
employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
description:
Job ID: 6455

Core Technology Change & Delivery is seeking an experienced Lead Project Leader to drive the delivery of critical technology capabilities enabling safe, scalable and compliant AI adoption across Nordea.

In this role, you will lead a portfolio of interdependent initiatives spanning AI governance, Identity & Access Management, network connectivity and security. You will translate strategic AI ambitions into executable delivery plans, establish effective governance and coordinate dependencies across architecture, infrastructure, security, risk and business teams.

You will play a key role in ensuring that foundational capabilities - including identity and privileged access, secure connectivity, network segmentation, platform controls and enterprise guardrails - are delivered in a coordinated, transparent and predictable manner.

About our team

Core Technology Change & Delivery team is responsible for the Project & Programme management, the delivery & execution and governance of our Change Initiatives  to ensure we meet our commitments in adherence to our Core Tech Operating Model and according to Nordea Delivery Guide.

Main responsibilities in this role:

    Lead end-to-end delivery of AI governance and technology-enabler initiatives across IAM, network and security domains.
    Establish and maintain integrated delivery plans covering scope, milestones, dependencies, resources, financials, risks and expected outcomes.
    Coordinate delivery across architecture, AI platform, IAM, network, security, cloud, risk, compliance and business teams.
    Translate AI platform and governance roadmaps into executable programmes and clearly sequenced delivery plans.
    Drive the implementation of foundational capabilities required for secure AI adoption, including identity federation, privileged access, connectivity, segmentation, platform security and enterprise guardrails.
    Establish governance frameworks, decision-making forums, controls and operating models supporting the adoption of emerging AI technologies.
    Facilitate governance and approval processes in line with internal policies, regulatory requirements and Nordea’s delivery framework.
    Proactively manage cross-domain dependencies, risks, issues and delivery constraints, escalating where required to maintain momentum and predictable execution.
    Drive alignment between enterprise architecture, security requirements, regulatory obligations and technology delivery roadmaps.
    Ensure operational readiness, including service ownership, support models, resilience, security controls and transition to operations.
    Provide senior stakeholders with concise, decision-oriented reporting on delivery status, financials, risks, dependencies and required actions.
    Promote a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Who you are

This is the right role for you if: you are a collaborative, pragmatic and solution-oriented leader who can bring diverse stakeholders together, challenge constructively and create clarity in a complex delivery environment. You combine strong programme leadership with enough understanding of AI governance, identity, network and security principles to ask the right questions, manage dependencies and drive informed decisions.  

Your background and skills include:

    Proven track record in leading complex cross-functional technology programmes.
    Strong experience coordinating initiatives spanning Identity & Access Management, Network, Security or enterprise governance functions.
    Experience establishing governance frameworks, controls and operating models supporting adoption of emerging technologies.
    Ability to manage complex dependency landscapes across infrastructure, security, architecture, risk and business stakeholders.
    Experience driving delivery of foundational technology capabilities required by strategic programmes and platforms.
    Strong understanding of security, regulatory and compliance considerations related to cloud and AI technologies.
    Experience facilitating governance forums and steering committees involving senior business and technology leaders.
    Ability to drive alignment between enterprise architecture, security requirements and technology delivery roadmaps.
    Strong understanding of identity, privileged access, connectivity, segmentation, platform security and risk management principles.
    Experience managing large-scale stakeholder ecosystems and influencing decisions across organisational boundaries.
    Very good financial and resource management skills.
    Very good analytical skills and attention to detail.
    Advanced presentation skills, especially PowerPoint and Excel.
    Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
    Excellent English skills, both spoken and written.
    Can-do attitude.



It would be ideal if you also:

    Have an interest in AI governance, AI platforms and emerging technology trends.
    Have experience working in highly regulated environments.
    Understand cloud platform operating models and enterprise security controls.
    Can translate strategic objectives into executable delivery plans and measurable outcomes.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

The recruitment process consists of the following steps:

    Preliminary CV selection
    Online interview with the hiring leader
    Background check

title: R&D Electrical Design Engineer
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
Join us in shaping the future of energy! As a Senior Electrical Engineer, you will play a vital role in modernizing our customers’ equipment and reducing their carbon footprint. You will be part of a dynamic team responsible for developing and maintaining standard solutions for control equipment while assisting with modernization projects for our gas and steam turbine fleet. In this fast-evolving energy landscape, you will tackle challenges such as rapid equipment superseding, the integration of renewable fuels, and driving innovative solutions to enhance fleet efficiency. Collaborating closely with various departments, you will engage in R&D projects, develop new solutions, and support existing products, all while enjoying the flexibility of a hybrid work environment. With access to a local test room, you can test your designs on current hardware and, in some cases, follow your design until installation on-site. Have you previously worked with us, perhaps as a technical field advisor, or are you looking to take the next step in your career? If so, we want to hear from you!



How You’ll Make an Impact



    You will lead the hardware design aspects of assigned tasks and R&D projects, focusing on developing standardized solutions for our steam and gas turbine fleet.
    You will have the opportunity to evolve your career, as we support roles in R&D, project delivery, troubleshooting, and commissioning for both new deliveries and service modifications.
    You will develop and maintain standardized technical solutions that modernize our growing fleet, ensuring they meet current and future demands.
    Through continuous business development, you will influence how our department organizes and executes projects moving forward.
    You will utilize your expertise in Comos and AutoCAD to create and modify electrical designs, ensuring compliance with safety and functional requirements.



What You Bring



    You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in electrical design, preferably within control equipment.
    You possess strong knowledge of Comos or a similar electrical database engineering tool and have experience with AutoCAD.
    Your strong cooperation skills and willingness to assist colleagues will be key to your success in this role.
    You are structured and driven in your daily work, ensuring tasks are completed efficiently.
    You can express yourself fluently in English, both verbally and in writing. Knowledge of Swedish is considered a merit.



About the Team
Our team is composed of eleven dedicated development engineers specializing in the instrumentation and control aspects of gas and steam turbine packages. We focus on creating standardized solutions for modernization and upgrade projects. With expertise in control systems, electrical engineering, instrumentation, cybersecurity, and functional safety, we support ongoing R&D projects and are responsible for sustaining all active products related to package instruments and controls. Our Gas Services division offers low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization, ensuring zero or low-emission power generation with all gas turbines, steam turbines, and generators under one roof. We provide decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.



Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.



We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.



Who is Siemens Energy?



At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.



Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.



Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo



Our Commitment to Diversity



Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.



Application



Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 303070 not later than 2026-10-05.



Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.



We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

title: Test System Engineer
description:
The opportunity

We are seeking a proactive and skilled Test system Engineer to develop, maintain, and improve the automation systems used in our advanced testing facilities for power electronics and HVDC converter valves at the HVDC Test Center.

In this role, you will be responsible for PLC programming, HMI development, control system troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of automated test systems. You will also support preventive maintenance activities and ensure the reliability, availability, and safety of critical test equipment and infrastructure.

You will be part of High Voltage Direct Current in Ludvika. We develop, manufacture, and sell DC transmission systems worldwide. HVDC technology is used to transfer electrical energy over long distances, enable power transmission through subsea cables, and connect power grids operating at different frequencies.

This role is based in Ludvika, Sweden.

How you’ll make an impact

    Develop and maintain PLC-based automation and control systems for advanced HVDC test equipment, including MACH.
    Design and enhance HMI solutions to improve usability, efficiency, and operational safety.
    Diagnose and resolve automation, control, and communication issues across complex test environments.
    Lead root cause investigations and drive corrective actions to improve system reliability and performance.
    Support commissioning, upgrades, and lifecycle management of test and automation systems.
    Ensure high equipment availability through preventive maintenance and continuous improvement initiatives.
    Collaborate with engineering, software, and manufacturing teams to deliver robust automation solutions.
    Utilize CMMS and other digital tools to track maintenance activities, equipment performance, and improvement initiatives.
    Ensure compliance with safety standards, regulations, and industrial control system requirements.
    Maintain technical documentation and provide technical guidance on automation systems and test equipment.

Your background

    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, or a related field.
    Hands-on experience with PLC programming, troubleshooting, and industrial automation platforms.
    Experience developing and maintaining HMI/SCADA solutions in industrial environments.
    Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Profinet, Profibus, Modbus, Ethernet/IP, or OPC UA.
    Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, control system documentation, and instrumentation drawings.
    Experience troubleshooting automated systems and performing root cause analysis.
    Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills, with the ability to work across multidisciplinary teams.
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​

Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​

    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​
    Group life insurance and additional insurances.​
    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​
    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​
    Health care and wellness allowance​
    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​
    Psychological support program​​
    Supplementary compensation for parental leave​
    Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​
    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​

title: Demand Planner
description:
We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups — and we’re just getting started.

At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future — and we want you to be part of it.

For this position we are seeking a motivated and curious individual who is proactive, analytical, and organized. You are good at building relationships, comfortable challenging the status quo and can adapt quickly to a fast-paced work environment. Additionally, you should enjoy working both collaboratively and independently. You will report to Johan Törnqvist, Demand Planning Manager.

About the role:

As a Demand Planner within Global Aftermarket Operations, you will work in a dynamic global environment and cross-functionally with sales, marketing, finance, product/part management, projects, quality and supply. Aftermarket plays a vital role in our future ambitions and is a key area of strategic investment. By developing services, spare parts, and customer-focused solutions, we create value long after the initial sale, helping customers get the most out of their products throughout their entire lifecycle.

Our demand planning is based on system generated statistical data-driven forecasts combined with market and product trends that need to be collected from various stakeholders such as sales, product management, quality, projects, etc. This means that collaboration and analytics skills are key. Our forecasting is also exception based driven meaning planning system generates alerts on a daily, weekly and monthly frequency for significant deviations between actual demand and forecasts.

Further key responsibilities:

    Responsible for generating global forecasts at article level for accessories and parts with 24-month rolling horizon and with high forecast accuracy.
    Configurate the system to provide the best statistical forecasts.
    Gather required market and product trends and information from different stakeholders such as Sales, Product/Part Management, Projects, Quality department, etc. to ensure top level forecast accuracy.
    Creating long-term relationships and co-operation with international colleagues within Husqvarna Group.
    Investigate forecast exceptions and determine appropriate actions.
    Ensuring accurate reporting, monitor and analyze of KPIs and take action to improve performance
    Generate and develop reports to analyze and share demand trends with different stakeholders along with reporting and analysis of data for preparing business decisions
    Lead global cross-functional meetings
    Actively contribute and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance higher forecast accuracy, streamline processes and increase efficiency within the demand planning process and planning systems.

Your skills and background

    Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, logistics, business administration or a related field.
    Experience in supply chain, forecasting processes and statistical modelling
    Advanced skills in Excel and excellent presentation and communication skills
    Fluent in English, both in speaking and writing
    Previous experience with demand planning from a global company and advanced global demand planning systems, e.g. Logility as well as experience from aftermarket is highly advantageous.
    Previous experience, knowledge and general curiosity about AI is advantageous.

Location:

This position will be placed in Huskvarna, Sweden. We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, at least 4 days a week (80%), creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making.

Your application:

Please submit your application in English as soon as possible as we will review applications on an ongoing basis. We do not accept applications via e-mail due to GDPR.

For questions about the role, reach out to hiring manager Johan Törnqvist, at johan.tornqvist@husqvarnagroup.com.

For questions about the recruitment process, reach out to Talent Acquisition Partner Nina Hallin at nina.hallin@husqvarnagroup.com.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Processing of personal data

When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we will ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer.

For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice.

Winning Through Culture

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.    

Our culture is built on three core themes:  

    Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
    Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!  

Learn more about our culture here.

title: Operatör inom produktion till Epiroc i Fagersta!
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Vill du arbeta i en modern produktionsmiljö där säkerhet, kvalitet och samarbete står i fokus? Vi söker nu en operatör till färdigställningsavdelningen i Fagersta.



Bli en del av vårt team



Hos oss blir du en del av Rock Drilling Tools-divisionen, som utvecklar och tillverkar produkter för bergborrning och bergförstärkning. På färdigställningsavdelningen ansvarar vi för det sista steget i produktionsprocessen, där vi säkerställer kvalitet, förstärker materialets egenskaper och förbereder produkterna för slutleverans.







Ditt uppdrag



Som operatör på färdigställningen ansvarar du för drift, operatörsunderhåll och kvalitetskontroller. Utifrån produktionsplaner hanterar du materialflödet och arbetar både självständigt och tillsammans med ditt skiftlag för att säkerställa hög kvalitet, leveransprecision och kontinuerliga förbättringar i verksamheten.



Arbetsuppgifter:




    Kulbombning och vakuumblästring för att förstärka materialet och avlägsna restprodukter.
    Manuell och automatisk riktning för att säkerställa att produkterna uppfyller höga krav på rakhet och måttnoggrannhet.
    Målning och slutbehandling inför leverans.
    Kvalitetskontroller, mätningar och avvikelsehantering.
    Drift, övervakning och operatörsunderhåll av produktionsutrustning.



Genom rotation mellan arbetsstationer får du på sikt en varierad vardag och möjlighet att utvecklas inom flera delar av produktionen.





Profile description:

Din profil



Vi söker dig som trivs med att ta ansvar och bidra med initiativ och förbättringsförslag. Du har ett starkt säkerhetstänk där du ser det som en självklarhet att följa säkerhetsrutiner och agera vid risker. Du arbetar noggrant och kvalitetsmedvetet, med förmåga att upptäcka avvikelser och säkerställa att arbetet håller hög standard. Samtidigt är du en lagspelare som tycker om att samarbeta med andra och bidra till teamets gemensamma resultat.



För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:




    Eftergymnasial utbildning, gärna med teknisk eller industriteknisk inriktning.
    Praktiskt handlag och gärna erfarenhet av maskiner, verktyg eller industriproduktion.
    Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift, för att kunna ta del av säkerhetsinstruktioner, dokumentation och skiftöverlämningar. Kunskaper i engelska är meriterande.
    Grundläggande datorvana eftersom produktion och avvikelser rapporteras digitalt.



Meriterande




    Erfarenhet från tillverkande industri.
    Truckkort samt B-körkort









We offer:

Placering, arbetstider och omfattning



Tjänsten är placerad i Fagersta, Sverige. Arbetstiden är skiftlagd och omfattar dag-, kvälls-, natt- och helgarbete.



Detta är en visstidsanställning med omgående start till och med den 31 december, med möjlighet till förlängning.







Livet på Epiroc



När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter.



Förutom att vi har en kultur som kännetecknas av utveckling i kombination med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, finns det några saker som gör oss lite extra stolta över att arbeta på Epiroc:




    Globala karriärmöjligheter.
    Epiroc University, för din egen kompetensutveckling.
    Samhällsengagemang.
    Förmånspaket, som bland annat inkluderar flexibel arbetstid och bonus.







Ansökan och kontaktinformation



Vi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt, men senast den 2/10 2026. Observera att ansökningar granskas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.



Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter.







För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta:



Ansvarig chef, Ronnie Bergner, ronnie.bergner@epiroc.com



Rekryteringsspecialist, Erika Örneus, erika.orneus@epiroc.com

title: Material modelling engineer
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
Join our dynamic Turbine Mechanical Integrity team as a Material Model Engineer! Imagine being at the forefront of innovation, where you will engage in the entire process—from test planning to the development and implementation of material models that are essential for our engineering team. You will collaborate closely with our colleagues in the materials laboratory, ensuring that your contributions directly impact our projects. Our team tackles a variety of tasks, including finite element (FE) analysis, alloy development, constitutive modeling, and methodology development, while also providing vital support to workshops, procurement, and service.



How You’ll Make an Impact



    Develop, implement, and enhance constitutive and life material models for high-temperature applications.
    Contribute to the development of methodologies and procedures for constitutive and life material modeling.
    Support development and technology projects by assessing, planning, and evaluating material testing.
    Provide assistance in response to inquiries from manufacturing and customers.



What You Bring



    A Ph.D. in Solid Mechanics or a related field.
    Extensive expertise in material modeling, backed by several years of experience and a solid theoretical foundation.
    Experience with FE analysis for lifing calculations, along with a strong understanding of relevant principles and methodologies.
    Proficiency in English, both verbal and written.
    A collaborative mindset paired with strong communication skills.



About the Team
You will be part of an experienced team with diverse backgrounds and responsibilities. We strive to support one another and build a strong technical knowledge base within the team. Our commitment to developing long-term competencies makes us an ideal environment for individuals eager to grow and advance their careers alongside us.



Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.



We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.



Who is Siemens Energy?



At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.



Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.



Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo



Our Commitment to Diversity



Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

title: Accounting Business Analyst
description:
We’re looking for an Accounting Business Analyst for a company in Stockholm. Start is ASAP, 9 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Stockholm.



Accounting Business Analyst

We are seeking a highly experienced accounting specialists for a consulting assignment within a large-scale financial transformation initiative.

The role requires strong hands-on experience in accounting and reconciliation of financial records in a complex enterprise environment. You are expected to independently analyse, design and document financial business processes from multiple front-end systems, detail resulting accounting patterns, in a complex enterprise environment.

﻿

ART Initiative

The company is running an initiative called ART, Accounting and Reporting Transformation, with the objective of moving accounting functionality from several legacy accounting solutions to a new cloud-based solution.

Integration with other systems is ongoing, including business applications delivering accounting data, source systems, and downstream consumers of accounting and reporting information.

﻿

The initiative includes several agile teams working across IT development, integration, infrastructure, security, and business processes. The solution includes development of customized bank-specific functionality running on dedicated server instances in the Oracle sovereign cloud, updates to legacy systems, and configuration and integration of an accounting SaaS solution provided by Oracle.

﻿

Required Skills & Experience

Strong ability to analyse accounting, reconciliation and reporting requirements and translate them into process descriptions, accounting patterns and system requirements

Hands-on and broad accounting experience and confident in describing accounting scenarios, for example using T-accounts

Strong ability to train and coach end-users to confidently and efficiently use the resulting accounting solutions

Experience in planning, preparing and executing tests of financial processes and accounting solutions in a large, multinational enterprise

Experience with financial services, accounting, regulatory reporting, and other highly regulated business domains

Experience working in agile development teams and collaborating across application, integration, test, and business functions

Strong written and spoken English communication skills

﻿

Education

Master’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field

Equivalent professional experience may be considered

﻿

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in integrating large scale and custom business applications using Oracle Financials Cloud or similar, comprehensive accounting system

Experience in Change Management, organizational transformation, and user training

﻿

Key Responsibilities

Analyse functional and non-functional requirements and translate those into accounting and configuration specifications

Translate business, accounting, reporting and reconciliation requirements into implementable system requirements

Support configuration, operation, and maintenance of an accounting solution based on Oracle Financials Cloud and other supporting financial solutions

Collaborate with business stakeholders, system architects, and development teams to clarify functional and non-functional requirements

Produce and maintain high-level and low-level design documentation and test-scripts

Support testing, deployment, release, troubleshooting, incident analysis, and remediation in non-production and production environments

Contribute to common accounting standards, reconciliation principles, and ways of working

Participate actively in agile ceremonies and cross-team planning

Share knowledge and provide solution guidance to other project team members when required

Training and coaching end-users in using the configured solution

﻿

Personal Attributes

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

High attention to quality, details and consistency

Ability to work independently and take end-to-end ownership of deliverables

Mind-set to drive continuous improvements within areas of responsibility but also within the team

Structured and methodical approach to complex assignments

Pragmatic mindset and ability to balance long-term targets with delivery needs

Effective communicator with both technical and business stakeholders

Comfortable working across accounting, system, reporting, and operational boundaries

Collaborative and team-oriented, with experience from agile environments

Able to document and explain accounting solutions and business decisions clearly

Proactive in identifying risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities

﻿

This role requires fluency in English.

This is a full-time consultant position in Stockholm through Incluso. Start is ASAP, 9 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Stockholm.

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

title: Lead Project Leader - AWS AI
employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
description:
Job ID: 6456

Core Technology Change & Delivery is seeking an experienced AWS AI Lead Project Leader to drive the delivery and governance of Nordea’s AWS-based AI platform initiatives.

In this role, you will lead complex, cross-functional delivery across AWS cloud foundations, AI platform capabilities, security, data and engineering. You will help establish governed, scalable and reusable services that enable AI use cases across Nordea, while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, regulatory and operational requirements.

You will translate strategic AI and cloud ambitions into executable plans, coordinate dependencies across multiple technology domains and provide clear, transparent reporting to senior stakeholders.

About our team

Core Technology Change & Delivery team is responsible for the Project & Programme management, the delivery & execution and governance of our Change Initiatives  to ensure we meet our commitments in adherence to our Core Tech Operating Model and according to Nordea Delivery Guide.

Main responsibilities in this role:

    Lead end-to-end delivery of AWS AI platform initiatives, from scope definition and planning through implementation, operational readiness and handover.
    Establish and maintain delivery plans covering milestones, dependencies, resources, financials, risks and expected outcomes.
    Coordinate delivery across cloud engineering, architecture, security, identity and access management, network, data, platform engineering and business teams.
    Drive the evolution of AWS cloud foundations required for scalable AI adoption, including landing-zone capabilities, deployment pipelines, runtime environments, connectivity and platform resilience.
    Enable reusable AWS AI services and platform components that support multiple AI use cases and teams across the organisation.
    Ensure alignment between business needs, AI use cases, platform capabilities, enterprise architecture and technology roadmaps.
    Facilitate governance and approval processes in line with internal policies, regulatory requirements and Nordea’s delivery framework.
    Establish clear decision-making forums, delivery standards, operating models and reporting practices.
    Proactively manage delivery risks, issues and cross-domain dependencies, escalating when required to maintain predictable execution.
    Drive operational readiness, including support models, service ownership, resilience, security, cost management and transition to operations.
    Engage senior stakeholders and provide concise, decision-oriented updates on delivery status, risks, financials and required actions.
    Promote a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, collaboration and continuous improvement.



Your background and skills include:

    Proven track record of leading complex technology programmes in AWS Cloud environments.
    Strong experience in AWS platform governance, cloud operating models, landing-zone implementation and platform evolution.
    Ability to scope, drive and govern AWS AI platform initiatives that provide reusable capabilities for scalable AI adoption.
    Experience leading delivery of AWS-native AI, machine learning and data services, with a clear understanding of how platform capabilities enable business use cases.
    Strong understanding of AI enablement platforms, including Generative AI, large language models, agentic or orchestration frameworks and model lifecycle management.
    Experience coordinating delivery across architecture, cloud engineering, security, identity and access management, network, data and platform teams.
    Ability to translate AI and AWS platform roadmaps into executable programmes, milestones and delivery plans.
    Strong understanding of platform-oriented delivery, including shared services, reusable components, automated onboarding and self-service capabilities.
    Experience establishing governance frameworks, delivery standards and operating models for large-scale cloud transformations.
    Understanding of cloud security, resilience, scalability, operational excellence and cost-management principles.
    Strong stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders, facilitate decisions and influence cross-functional teams.
    Very good financial, resource, risk and dependency-management skills.
    Very good analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to turn complex information into clear recommendations and actions.
    Advanced presentation and reporting skills, particularly using PowerPoint and Excel.
    Excellent communication skills and the ability to bring clarity in both written and verbal communication.
    Excellent English skills, both spoken and written.
    A proactive, pragmatic and solution-oriented attitude.

The role is specifically positioned around Nordea’s AWS AI platform rather than generic multi-cloud delivery. This is consistent with the planned AWS capabilities for enterprise-scale AI adoption and the current focus on a governed, scalable platform supporting AWS ecosystems.

What we offer

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

People are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

title: International Trainee - Property Development and Construction Management
description:
Företagsbeskrivning

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

Om rollen

Shape the future of energy.

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives and contribute to solving one of society's most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall and contribute to the energy transition from day one.



About the traineeship.  

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each of the trainee positions is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area and working location. This means that each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges and matching profile.

What you will experience

    Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges.
    Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall's different markets, business areas and locations through programme activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration.
    Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm, explains, “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”  

  

Your role as a Trainee - Property Development and Construction Management

You will join Property Development and Construction Management. We are involved in all phases of project development, from early-stage feasibility studies and planning to project execution and completion. Our focus is on managing and addressing construction-related issues throughout the development process to ensure successful project delivery.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to participate in and support feasibility studies, including meetings and activities aimed at enabling efficient project delivery. You will also gain experience in later project phases, working alongside Construction Managers on tasks such as cost control, contractor management, risk management, and other construction-related matters.

This is an excellent opportunity to gain insight into the entire construction and development process and contribute throughout all project phases. Typical responsibilities may include participating in, and eventually supporting, Real Estate Developers in negotiations and project planning during the early stages of development. You will also assist Construction Managers in documenting project deficiencies and quality issues, and over time develop the ability to independently evaluate construction-related challenges and propose solutions under the guidance of experienced colleagues.



Your responsibilities:  

    Support Construction Managers with the documentation of construction-related defects and project issues
    Participate in technical drawing reviews to ensure compliance with project requirements and construction standards.
    Support real estate developers in managing construction-related matters during feasibility study phase and early-stage project development.
    Provide administrative support across construction and development projects
    Collaborate with internal teams and external contractors to support efficient project delivery.

Kravspecifikation

Your qualifications as a Trainee - Property Development and Construction Management

    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Urban Development and Infrastructure, or a related field.
    Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

You should also recognize yourself in

    You are comfortable navigating different perspectives and balancing the interests of multiple stakeholders.
    You are proactive, curious, and eager to take initiative while maintaining a humble attitude and a willingness to learn.
    You are open-minded and receptive to new ideas, while also able to make sound decisions when needed.
    You have strong communication and collaboration skills and enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams.

Whether you aspire to become an energy specialist, project manager, digital expert, engineer or future leader, the International Trainee Programme offers opportunities to explore your potential and build a meaningful career.

As Cato, a former International Trainee based in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”  

To be considered for our traineeship, you should:  

    Have completed, or expect to complete, an academic degree before the programme starts in March 2027
    Have no more than one year of relevant work experience after graduation, excluding internships and working-student roles
    Be fluent in English
    Be available for the full-time programme from its start date
    Have the right to work in the country where the position is based, or meet the stated work-permit requirements
    Be open to mobility opportunities and collaborating across different locations.
    Demonstrate curiosity, initiative and growth mindset while sharing our values: Active, Open, Positive and Safe.

Location:

You will be working in the department Construction and Property Development and be located in Solna, Trollhättan or Gothenburg, (Sweden).

Ytterligare information

Our offer

“Vattenfall provides me with the steepest learning curve. We are a group that feels connected by our core values in line with the organization's values: Open, Active, Positive and Safe.

title: International Trainee  Analyst Group Strategy
description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

Job Description

Shape the future of energy.

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives and contribute to solving one of society's most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall and contribute to the energy transition from day one.

About the traineeship.

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each of the trainee positions is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area and working location. title: IT Support to Paradox Interactive!
description:
Step into a tech adventure with Padarox Interactive! A unique opportunity for a gaming enthusiast to dive into a diverse role, tackling everything from software wizardry to hardware magic. Join a team that values your passion for technology and offers a vibrant, inclusive culture.

About the role

Paradox Interactive is one of the premier game developers and publishers of strategy and management games on PC and consoles! In this position, you'll play a crucial role in providing day-to-day technical support to your colleagues in the organization. You together with a team of 10 will provide seamless support to 800 colleagues in multiple global offices.

Responsible for day-to-day technical support, your role includes troubleshooting hardware and software issues both on-site and remotely. You play a vital role in the smooth onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring the seamless integration of hardware, software, and other services. Additionally, you take charge of the functionality of conference rooms and office IT equipment, ensuring a conducive environment for smooth operations.

You are offered

    Great culture with social hours, board games, and quiz nights
    A great role to deepen your knowledge within tech
    A dedicated consultant manager from Academic Work who will support and coach you in your future career

Work tasks

    Configure and troubleshoot software for seamless operations both on site and remote  
    Install and set up new computers, addressing hardware issues  
    Provide remote support to offices globally, contributing to a smooth tech environment  
    Collaborate with the support team on projects for infrastructure scaling and updates  
    Ensure the functionality of conference rooms and office IT equipment

We are looking for

    Work experience in IT support/IT related customer service
    Has an interest in hardware and technology
    Good knowledge of English in both speech and writing as it is used in daily work

It is meritorious if you have

    

● Worked in onsite experience in IT support previously

● Prior experience in networking and/or PC hardware troubleshooting

● Gaming interest

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:

    Service-minded
    Curious nature
    Problem solver
    Adaptable

Paradox value attitude and personality. They seek individuals with a positive mindset, knowledge of technology, and a genuine interest in providing top-notch service. It's also important that you thrive in a culture where they embrace diversity in cultures, geographies, and languages.

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Junior Operative Purchaser
description:
Junior Operative Purchaser – Harnesses & Components

We are looking for a Junior Operative Purchaser to join a procurement organization within a fast-paced production environment in the Stockholm area. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in supply, sourcing or operational purchasing who enjoys working closely with suppliers, planning teams and project stakeholders.

🛒 About the role

As an Operative Purchaser, you will be responsible for placing purchase orders, following up deliveries and ensuring that materials and services are available according to production requirements and project milestones.

The role requires a structured and proactive approach, as you will manage several interfaces and need to respond quickly when priorities or delivery conditions change.

📋 Key responsibilities

    

Purchase materials and services based on planned requirements.

    

Place and manage purchase orders.

    

Expedite orders and follow up deliveries.

    

Obtain and follow up cost estimates.

    

Manage supplier invoices.

    

Provide ongoing feedback and status updates to relevant stakeholders.

    

Build and maintain supplier relationships.

    

Follow up supplier performance and delivery precision.

    

Support optimization of purchasing and material flows.

    

Collaborate closely with planning teams and different project functions.

🎯 Qualifications

We are looking for someone who has:

    

A Bachelor's degree or relevant professional experience within supply, sourcing or purchasing.

    

Previous experience within supply, sourcing or operational purchasing is highly advantageous.

    

Good understanding of purchasing within a supply chain and production environment.

    

Ability to independently follow up suppliers and drive activities to ensure good delivery precision.

    

Strong communication and collaboration skills.

    

A structured, proactive and solution-oriented approach.

    

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and changing production environment.

You are a team player who takes responsibility, acts proactively and maintains focus on delivery and overall objectives.

🔐 Security requirements

The position requires successful completion of a security vetting process in accordance with applicable security protection regulations. Depending on the required security classification, additional requirements regarding citizenship may apply.
